spans.s: यौगपद्य simultaneity of occurrence; simultaneous possibility of the application of two rules which evidently cannot apply simulta- neously, but scope has to be given to one of the two, the priority being decided on the criteria of परत्व, नित्यत्व, अन्तरङ्गत्व and अपवादत्व;cf. न चास्ति यौगपदद्येन संभव: M.
